title: ReceiptEnvelope
description: A receipt with its signature: the file that a lab gives with a result.

signature.description:
The Ed25519 signature over the UTF-8 bytes of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of `receipt`,
in base64url with no padding.

Receipt.description:
What a lab signs: which result it stands behind, for which build, on which device, and the
device's readings.

build_id.description: The build id of the files the lab ran: 64 lower-case hex characters.

check_id.description: The lab's id for the run.

dyno_version.description: The dyno version that made the result.

issued_at.description: When the lab signed: RFC 3339, in UTC, to the second, ending in `Z`.

issuer.description: The lab's name, such as a domain.

key_id.description:
Which of the lab's keys signed: the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the raw
32-byte public key.

protocol.description:
How the lab ran the check: the host profile's name and version, the scenario, the spins
and the device runs. [`ReceiptProtocol`] is the object that dyno writes. A receipt from
another signer can name its fields in another way, so a reader gets the object as it is.

result_hash.description: The result's own `result_hash`, as the result states it. Null when it states none.

result_sha256.description: Lower-case hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of the whole result file.

ReceiptDevice.description: The device that ran the check.

key.description: The device catalogue's key, such as "iphone-14-pro-max".

model.description: The model's name, such as "iPhone 14 Pro Max". Null when the result does not name it.

os_version.description: The OS version, such as "26.6.2 (23G90)". Null when the result does not give it.

ReceiptLab.description: The lab that ran the check.

backend.description:
What the lab's devices run on, such as the name of a device cloud. Null when the lab does
not say.

kind.description: What kind of lab it is, in the lab's own words.

unit.description: The unit, such as "bytes". Null when the signer does not give it.

value.description: The reading, in the measure's unit. Null when the device gave none.
